g.title: legend
g.text: Traditional REE chain vs. Noveon EcoFlux
Note: EcoFlux exact gallons not public; comparison is relative.

g.title: compare
g.text: Relative gallons per kg finished magnet:
- Very high (mining + flotation + leaching + solvent extraction)
- Much lower (recycling route; skips mining & oxide separation)

g.title: t8
g.text: 8. The only major rare-earth mine and separation facility in the US.
consumed:--> u+27F6 850–1,200 gallons of water per minute
These figures come from environmental filings
historical operational reports from the mine’s earlier operational phases.

g.title: n7
g.text: 7. A 150,000-sq-ft advanced type manufacturing facility typically uses
tens of thousands to low hundreds of thousands of gallons per month
this is an industry-typical estimate, not specific data
Surface w.meter readings are not public

g.title: n_water
g.text: but no ore mining, no oxide separation)
